# gantt fixtures

- `docs-basic.mmd`, `docs-syntax.mmd`: examples from the Mermaid gantt
  documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/gantt.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `release-plan.mmd`: the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed.
- `hours-cjk.mmd`, `compact-excludes.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this
  crate: time-of-day formats, CJK labels, compact rows, excluded and
  included days, inclusive end dates, `vert`, `todayMarker` and `click`.
